<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Election preparedness:</strong> Prime Minister Modi chaired a meeting with NDA leaders to strategize ahead of the upcoming Lok Sabha election results.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxQd1lhSkZhakVya3dsZDdZVHlHLVp1SmY5dDF6czRxc3ZwaGtGY3UyMU1MdE5Nb3RWQlNIcW1nYkRKZ0pmM3UtMVdnYldWSHpqVDJlamJoeFgwekRXNzNzYVB1VmZGbDlPdEFKZE5tOVBxWTRZanVnTy0ta1FPdmlkaGx4YXBIWC1Ddm9iYWM2MEtyMzFuRnc?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Parliamentary concerns:</strong> Opposition leaders and legal experts have raised alarms over the passage of bills without debate and the potential erosion of parliamentary deliberation.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Judicial intervention:</strong> Chief Justice of India Surya Kant stated that the judiciary has proactively addressed &quot;digital arrest&quot; scams rather than waiting for legislative action from Parliament.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxOU3dhZEF4cmlJWU02NXhCUXlPTzE0WXBnWFBMYUtHMmhGYnJzNTJkYzBlSEF6Mnowc0ZTSXc2RjlzdlFlYXpZejkzS21vUmdKZlRlaU03RkduQWdxc1M2OVktTUxyQWdGRUNEV183WnVGdDhRNllsNDZ4NlNtNTdkNmszdlJNazNuODA2WkRzdEpYZGw4UzJySEd1R1M4UXpDQ1BfRHZBLURReXoxekFTR2lR?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a></span></li>
